evidence.title: GitHub - SSShooter/mindmapcn: Beautiful mind maps, works seamlessly with shadcn/ui.

name: mindmapcn
summary: Mind map component for React and shadcn/ui projects, built on Mind Elixir with theme-aware styling, zoom and export controls.
description: A mind map component installed into a shadcn/ui project with one command, based on Mind Elixir and styled with Tailwind. It adapts to light and dark mode automatically, needs zero config and adds zoom, fit-to-screen and export controls; suited to organizational charts, project planning, knowledge graphs and brainstorming. Docs and live examples at mindmapcn.mind-elixir.com.
contains: single mind map component, one-command install into a shadcn/ui project
powered by Mind Elixir, styled with Tailwind
theme-aware: auto light/dark mode, zero-config defaults
rich styling options, uses shadcn/ui patterns and conventions
MIT license; 86 GitHub stars; examples at mindmapcn.mind-elixir.com
